name: fanzhuan-zuolun
description: 翻转左轮 — 2 人联机回合制网页棋牌游戏（服务端权威）

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm --workspace @zuolun/server run dev" "npm --workspace @zuolun/client run dev"
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:integration
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
